name: Wendy Lu
bio: Wendy is an iOS engineer and has been working at Pinterest for the last 5 years. She is currently engineering manager of the Ad Formats team with a focus on mobile. Previously, she led the launch of their commerce product on mobile and has also touched everything from the data layer to the UI frameworks. She has given talks at several iOS conferences and moderates a mobile development panel at Grace Hopper. In a past life she competed on the US Synchronised Swimming National Team.
